policy: Visual audit findings, not architectural certification; existing published permissions are not rewritten by this report. Uncommitted batch04 and pilot correction are held from release.

reference.warning: Reference artwork itself has unverified historical details. Match graphic treatment, not its fortification plan or flags.

entries.name: Athens
entries.observed_issues: Invented water at inland city; ungrounded outer wall ring. Acropolis and roofed Parthenon distinguish site, but lower city remains schematic.

entries.name: Thessaloniki
entries.observed_issues: Site identity depends on a generic upper citadel and large church. Wall circuit, Rotunda and harbor relationships not checked against a period plan.

entries.name: Corinth
entries.observed_issues: Invented waterfront at lower Corinth. Acrocorinth-to-town distances compressed; castle layers and church placement not plan-checked.

entries.name: Chalkida
entries.observed_issues: Bridge gives useful identity, but town-on-water composition, wall ring and bridge form are reconstructions without plan evidence.

entries.name: Heraklion
entries.observed_issues: Nearly interchangeable with Rhodes: compact wall ring, tiled houses, domed church, semicircular harbor. No documented1180 street or wall plan.

entries.name: Rhodes
entries.observed_issues: Nearly interchangeable with Heraklion. Omitting Knights buildings does not establish the Byzantine city plan or harbor circuit.

entries.name: Cairo
entries.observed_issues: Invented or misplaced water strip beside generic circular walled core. Repeated flat-roof houses and mosque silhouettes are not a checked Fatimid plan.

entries.name: Alexandria
entries.observed_issues: Pharos adds identity; lighthouse tiers, scale and medieval state need checking. Walls and port are generalized. Compare specific shoreline evidence.

entries.name: Damietta
entries.observed_issues: Medieval site coordinate unresolved. East-bank port concept only; river geometry, enclosing walls and housing are hypothetical.

entries.name: Patras
entries.observed_issues: Coastal town below castle is identifiable, but generic wall/harbor/church arrangement repeats earlier assets. Castle phases need evidence.

entries.name: Thebes
entries.observed_issues: Inland setting is right; generic ring-walled hill town lacks evidence for Theban layout and textiles-era urban fabric.

entries.name: Rosetta
entries.observed_issues: River-side settlement is distinct from Greek sprites, but houses, mosque and quay are generic; medieval riverbank and urban extent unchecked.

entries.name: Tinnis
entries.observed_issues: Island setting is useful. Circular wall and town layout are invented; occupation intensity in1180 remains uncertain.

entries.name: Bilbeis
entries.observed_issues: Inland setting retained, but generic circular fortified town; wall form and reconstructed post1168 settlement lack plan evidence.

entries.name: Jaffa
entries.observed_issues: Hill/roadstead silhouette is site-specific. Compare directly with recovered original; summit castle, church and housing still schematic.

entries.name: Methoni
entries.observed_issues: Peninsula identity is useful; invented wall line, gate and church forms. Earlier Byzantine phase needs evidence beyond excluding Venetian additions.

entries.name: Koroni
entries.observed_issues: Promontory identity is useful; steep terrain and ring fortifications remain ungrounded. Similar architecture repeats other Greek sprites.

entries.name: Andravida
entries.observed_issues: Unfortified flat-town brief followed. Pre1204 building evidence is weak, so church designs and settlement extent remain hypothetical.

entries.name: Chania
entries.observed_issues: Corrected cutout is usable. It depicts an enclosure with few houses; medieval settlement intensity, hill form and church plan remain uncertain.

entries.name: Rethymno
entries.observed_issues: Earlier small settlement intent is clear; circular wall and church/harbor layout were generated rather than reconstructed.

entries.name: Suez
entries.observed_issues: Small decayed settlement matches research direction. Coarse modern city point is not medieval registration; mosque and harbor are hypothetical.

entries.name: Nafpaktos
entries.observed_issues: Uncommitted draft has broad colored haze. Hill-town/harbor is recognizable; stacked walls and buildings mix schematic details without phase verification.

entries.name: Monemvasia
entries.observed_issues: Rock-islet silhouette is distinctive. Lower-town scale, causeway and upper church still require specific1180 plan evidence. No release review completed.

entries.name: Corfu
entries.observed_issues: Two-crest peninsula concept is distinctive. Towers, suburbs and coastline are schematic; no demonstrated1180 reconstruction. No release review completed.

entries.name: Chios
entries.observed_issues: Uncommitted draft became a full landscape with cross-marked sails. Later cutout attempts were not adopted. No period plan or final alpha review.

entries.name: Ascalon
entries.observed_issues: Uncommitted draft became a framed heraldic illustration. Semicircular concept exists but composition and decorative flags break sprite brief.

entries.name: Beirut
entries.observed_issues: Uncommitted draft has landscape/haze; cathedral and seafort are generic. Historic-core point does not verify the depicted urban plan.

findings: Approval was synthesized automatically in the city import loop rather than supplied by an individual visual/historical acceptance record.
Original city style was progressively replaced by assistant-generated references, including Belvoir v2.
Sourced coordinates locate sites; they do not verify painted orientations, wall circuits, waterfronts or building phases.
Technical RGBA and padding checks cannot detect invented water, wrong urban plans or neighboring crop fragments.
release_gate_fix: City batch importer now requires explicit published-provisional batch release status. Existing three published batches retain release history; unfinished batch04 is audit-hold and not imported.
